item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Defines `tools: list[dspy.Tool]` as input and separate `answer` plus `tool_calls: dspy.ToolCalls` outputs exactly as required."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Uses `JSONAdapter(use_native_function_calling=True)` and an LM subclass with `supports_function_calling = True`."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Stub response has `content=None`, `finish_reason='tool_calls'`, and raw tool-call arguments as the JSON string `\"{\\\"city\\\":\\\"Paris\\\"}\"`."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Captures `last_kwargs` in `forward` and asserts `last_kwargs['tools'][0]['function']['name'] == 'weather'`, proving tool schema transmission."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Builds the expected structured `dspy.ToolCalls(...ToolCall(name='weather', args={'city': 'Paris'}))` and asserts equality with parsed output."},{"claim_id":"c6","score":"1","rationale":"Explicitly asserts `res['answer'] is None` while `res['tool_calls']` is populated, proving the no-text normalization path."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
